title: Daily Brief eval answer key (expected_findings.json), any fixture
description: Iteration 3 (2026-10-06). Read by evals/score_brief.py. Every check is driven by these fields; nothing in the scorer is project-specific. Constructs with gate=true must pass for the scorer GATE; others are informational. Optional sibling files in the fixture dir: _ref_index.json (fabricated-ref check), reference_ranking.json (top-7 overlap).

recall_min.description: A1 recall threshold. Default: miss at most one must_surface finding.

above.description: finding id that must rank higher (smaller top rank)

source.description: brief freshness source; aliases: email/mail/mailbox -> msgraph_outlook, p6/xer -> schedule

must_state.description: prose; ISO dates and email addresses in it must appear in the source's freshness entry

freshness_band.description: prose starting with or containing fresh|aging|stale|missing; the entry band must match (aging also accepts stale)

checks.description: explicit machine checks overriding what is extracted from must_state/freshness_band. With nothing extractable, the entry only needs a last_successful_sync or as_of_label.

status_items.description: Optional per fixture. Only entries with `checks` are scored; others are human-judged.

section.description: brief sections key (required for in_section / not_in_section)

rank_expectation.description: 'top N' is checked; anything else is informational

key_facts.description: number | ISO date | string | {value, tolerance|tolerance_pct} | list | bool (bool = not machine-checked)

expected_label.description: the matched unit's confidence must be one of these

forbidden_label.description: the matched unit's confidence must not be one of these

section.description: management_attention (= top_items + action_items) | top_items | action_items | decisions (= new + unresolved) | status | freshness | gaps | any brief sections key

value.description: ISO date (matches YYYY-MM-DD or M/D) or a case-insensitive substring

scope.description: related = only units for this finding (matched/citing a required citation; action items that unblock them); section = anywhere in the section

ref.description: violation = a brief unit whose primary (first) citation is this ref (new_decisions excluded)

scope.description: top_items_only: only a top item counts as a violation
